name: Silver Queen
description: The classic Aglaonema with long, lance-shaped leaves that are predominantly silver with green margins.

name: Silver Bay
description: A robust variety featuring broad, oval leaves with a solid silver center and irregular green borders.

name: Siam Aurora
description: Also known as the Red Aglaonema, it has vibrant red stems and leaf edges outlining green centers.

name: Crete
description: Features broad green leaves heavily splashed with deep red and pink variegation.

name: Maria
description: A tough variety with dark green leaves patterned with silvery-green chevrons. Very tolerant of low light.

name: Sparkling Sarah
description: Eye-catching foliage with pink stems and midribs, and leaves speckled with pink and green.

name: Lady Valentine
description: Stunning leaves that start pink and develop green spotting as they mature, often mostly pink.

name: Cutlass
description: Distinctive long, narrow, blade-like leaves that are silvery-green with darker green edges.

name: Emerald Bay
description: Similar to Silver Bay but often has a more distinct emerald green margin and silvery-feathered center.

name: First Diamond
description: Showy white foliage with green speckles and margins, brightening up any shady corner.
